title: The Almost Prom
author: Coral Hartwell
blurb: Ivo Almeida, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
